# observe_group (Resource)

A monitor group, for reports and the dashboard.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "observe_group" "storefront" {
  name        = "Storefront"
  monitor_ids = [observe_monitor.shop.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `monitor_ids` (List of String)
- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID; defaults to the provider's `organization_id`

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <organization_id>/<id>, or <id> when the provider sets organization_id
terraform import observe_group.example 01JCX4ZK7N2Q8V3W5Y6A9B0C1D/01JCX5A2B3C4D5E6F7G8H9J0K1
```
